tools.name: Next.js App Router
tools.fit: React application shell with server rendering, nested layouts and a backend for the frontend.
tools.tradeoff: Keep secrets in server modules. Move long runs into a durable execution service.
tools.prompt: Render the run header on the server and hydrate only the interactive graph and controls.

tools.name: React
tools.fit: Composable client islands for a rich operator interface.
tools.tradeoff: A high-frequency trace can re-render the whole screen if state lives at the root.
tools.prompt: Subscribe each node to its own projected state and keep immutable event records outside the view.

tools.name: Vite
tools.fit: Fast development and a static SPA when an existing API owns all business logic.
tools.tradeoff: Authentication callbacks, routing and deployment rewrites are separate choices.
tools.prompt: Ship the SPA from a CDN and point its typed API client at the regional backend.

tools.name: Angular
tools.fit: Opinionated framework for teams with an established Angular platform and design system.
tools.tradeoff: React graph and chat widgets need equivalents or explicit integration boundaries.
tools.prompt: Use the existing Angular shell, routing and forms. Keep the run-event schema framework independent.

tools.name: Nuxt
tools.fit: Full-stack option for Vue teams needing server routes and hybrid rendering.
tools.tradeoff: Budget for Vue-native graph, form and component choices.
tools.prompt: Keep the same tenant-scoped HTTP and event contracts behind a Nuxt application.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.fit: Fast implementation of tokens, layouts, breakpoints and state styles.
tools.tradeoff: Unrestricted utility choices fragment color, spacing and density.
tools.prompt: Expose semantic CSS variables for canvas, surface, focus, critical, and selection. Use logical spacing for RTL.

tools.name: shadcn/ui
tools.fit: Editable source components for a branded product with dialogs, sheets, comboboxes and sidebars.
tools.tradeoff: Your team owns edits and upstream merges. Record the chosen primitive family.
tools.prompt: Start with the sidebar, command, sheet and dialog components. Implement the same focus and density rules in each.

tools.name: Base UI
tools.fit: Headless React behavior under a custom skin, including the default foundation for new shadcn projects.
tools.tradeoff: Composition and slot APIs differ across primitive families.
tools.prompt: Choose the Base UI shadcn preset. Use documented trigger composition and test the focus return path.

tools.name: Radix Primitives
tools.fit: Unstyled interactive primitives for an existing Radix-based component library.
tools.tradeoff: Mixing dialog or popover systems complicates portals, stacking and focus.
tools.prompt: Keep the existing Radix primitives for menus, dialogs and tooltips and share one overlay policy.

tools.name: React Aria Components
tools.fit: Accessible behavior for custom collections and internationalized forms with complex keyboard navigation.
tools.tradeoff: The team still owns styling, localization QA and assistive-technology testing.
tools.prompt: Use React Aria for the date range and selection controls. Test Arabic labels, keyboard selection and focus restoration.

tools.name: Material UI
tools.fit: A consistent React product suite where Material patterns are already familiar.
tools.tradeoff: A proprietary visual identity may require theme work. Evaluate MUI X editions separately.
tools.prompt: Use one MUI theme for data entry, alerts and navigation. Document density and touch target overrides.

tools.name: Mantine
tools.fit: Broad React component coverage for internal admin apps with a small frontend team.
tools.tradeoff: A second full component kit increases CSS and visual drift.
tools.prompt: Build the settings console on Mantine and use its theme primitives throughout the form.

tools.name: Carbon Design System
tools.fit: Enterprise information density, data tables, accessibility guidance and consistent component vocabulary.
tools.tradeoff: Adopting its visual language works best when product and design agree to it.
tools.prompt: Refer to Carbon table selection, toolbar placement and side panels for operator workflows.

tools.name: Motion for React
tools.fit: State-driven layout, entry and exit transitions for a live interface.
tools.tradeoff: Repeated layout animations compete with streaming updates. Respect reduced motion.
tools.prompt: Animate a handoff once when its persisted edge event arrives. Keep a static arrow and text for reduced motion.

tools.name: GSAP
tools.fit: Seekable timelines for replay, with MotionPathPlugin for packets moving along curved SVG edges and ScrollTrigger for explainers.
tools.tradeoff: Use one clock per property. Keep live arrival order independent of presentation time and review licensing for redistribution.
tools.prompt: Map a recorded event sequence to timeline labels. Seek deterministically, restore node state on scrub and use a stationary directional label under reduced motion.

tools.name: Rive
tools.fit: Designer-authored stateful animation for a device, robot or illustrated process.
tools.tradeoff: Requires an art asset, renderer budget and fallback semantics.
tools.prompt: Bind the device visual to idle, processing and fault states. Publish equivalent text and a static fallback.

tools.name: React Flow
tools.fit: Interactive dependency graphs with custom nodes, selection, pan and zoom.
tools.tradeoff: Layout and execution come from separate systems. Dense graphs need a timeline alternative.
tools.prompt: Use @xyflow/react for read-only execution topology. Inspect a node by mouse or keyboard and match its timeline row.

tools.name: ELK.js
tools.fit: Automatic graph layout for branching plans or nested dependencies.
tools.tradeoff: Repeated layout causes jitter and main-thread stalls.
tools.prompt: Compute the layered layout in a worker on topology changes, then animate only the active edge.

tools.name: Apache ECharts
tools.fit: Linked time-series views, distributions and operational metrics.
tools.tradeoff: Highly configurable charts require deliberate units, missing-data handling and accessible summaries.
tools.prompt: Show queue wait and tool latency separately with p50 and p95. Provide a table for the selected time window.

tools.name: MapLibre GL JS
tools.fit: Map rendering for fleet, incident and site operations with your own style and tile choices.
tools.tradeoff: Budget tile hosting, attribution and offline behavior separately.
tools.prompt: Cluster sites by zoom. Selecting a marker and selecting its table row must open the same incident.

tools.name: deck.gl
tools.fit: GPU-accelerated geospatial layers for dense telemetry and paths.
tools.tradeoff: Payload volume and GPU memory matter on low-end devices.
tools.prompt: Add a time-windowed trajectory layer over the basemap and bound the number of rendered points.

tools.name: React Three Fiber
tools.fit: React renderer for a real 3D inspection task or digital twin.
tools.tradeoff: 3D scenes add asset weight and GPU load. Define what decision needs the extra dimension.
tools.prompt: Lazy-load the equipment view only on inspection, show loading state and offer a labeled 2D schematic.

tools.name: TanStack Table
tools.fit: Headless sorting, filtering and column models for queues built to your own design system.
tools.tradeoff: You implement semantics, keyboard behavior, pagination UI and rendering.
tools.prompt: Build a URL-filtered queue with stable row IDs and preserve the selected run when the sort changes.

tools.name: TanStack Virtual
tools.fit: Window long timelines and lists whose DOM cost becomes measurable.
tools.tradeoff: Dynamic row heights and keyboard focus require testing.
tools.prompt: Virtualize the event history, preserve the scroll anchor, and announce new rows without stealing focus.

tools.name: AG Grid
tools.fit: Spreadsheet-like analysis with commercial options for pivoting, grouping and server-side row models.
tools.tradeoff: Check feature entitlement and licensing before choosing a grid module.
tools.prompt: Use Enterprise only when pivot or the Server-Side Row Model is required and licensed. Specify large-data tests.

tools.name: TanStack Query
tools.fit: Server-state cache for authorized run lists, evidence and details.
tools.tradeoff: A query cache shared across tenant switches can expose stale data.
tools.prompt: Scope query keys to tenant and run, cancel stale queries on switch, and clear tenant data on sign-out.

tools.name: React Hook Form
tools.fit: Performance-conscious forms for case intake and reviewer decisions.
tools.tradeoff: Client errors can drift from server validation.
tools.prompt: Validate on submit with the shared schema, retain typed fields after a server error and focus the first invalid control.

tools.name: Zod
tools.fit: Runtime schemas at TypeScript boundaries for inputs, tool arguments and streamed events.
tools.tradeoff: Shape validation alone grants no authority over an object.
tools.prompt: Parse unknown payloads server-side, authorize referenced resources and reject unsupported event versions.

tools.name: XState
tools.fit: Explicit client state machines for reconnect, review and replay controls.
tools.tradeoff: Duplicating the backend workflow in the browser creates conflicting states.
tools.prompt: Model only view modes and connection states in XState. Derive business status from ordered events.

tools.name: AI Elements
tools.fit: Editable UI components for messages, tool output, sources and AI-assisted workflows.
tools.tradeoff: Map runtime events to view models. Review components that display sensitive details.
tools.prompt: Use a tool card with name, elapsed time, scrubbed input summary and result link. Keep approvals server-authorized.

tools.name: assistant-ui
tools.fit: Conversation-first React UI with thread primitives and runtime integration.
tools.tradeoff: A chat thread alone gives poor visibility into parallel work.
tools.prompt: Attach a thread to the selected run and preserve links from each tool result to its evidence.

tools.name: CopilotKit
tools.fit: Embedded copilots that read scoped application context and expose interactive actions.
tools.tradeoff: Define exactly which state and actions a user session may share.
tools.prompt: Mount a contextual copilot on one case. Confirm each write through the same server policy as a normal button.

tools.name: AG-UI
tools.fit: Event protocol between different agent runtimes and interactive clients.
tools.tradeoff: Choose supported event types and version an adapter to the business event log.
tools.prompt: Map run, tool and lifecycle updates through an adapter and preserve your own replay cursor.

tools.name: json-render
tools.fit: Schema-constrained generative UI from a registered component and action catalog.
tools.tradeoff: Models need a small catalog, strict validation and an ordinary fallback for invalid specs.
tools.prompt: Allow Summary, EvidenceList and ApprovalRequest. Validate props and authorize any action on the server.

tools.name: A2UI
tools.fit: Declarative UI descriptions for an agent to request widgets across renderer implementations.
tools.tradeoff: Confirm schema and renderer compatibility before promising a cross-client feature.
tools.prompt: Negotiate a supported catalog, reject unknown actions and provide a generic read-only fallback.

tools.name: Streamdown
tools.fit: Streaming Markdown rendering when prose arrives incrementally.
tools.tradeoff: Treat links and embedded content as untrusted and constrain optional heavy renderers.
tools.prompt: Keep partial Markdown readable, restrict link schemes, and render code as text until the fence is closed.

tools.name: eve
tools.fit: Integrated TypeScript harness for Vercel-first apps with durable runs, subagents and approvals.
tools.tradeoff: Recently reached 1.0. Validate region, export, run retention, sandbox limits and your recovery path.
tools.prompt: Use eve as the sole run owner. Map its tool, approval and completion transitions to a durable public event log.

tools.name: LangGraph
tools.fit: Explicit state graphs for conditional routing, parallel branches, joins and human review.
tools.tradeoff: You own state schemas, checkpoint storage, tool idempotency and schema migrations.
tools.prompt: Use a persistent checkpointer, stable thread IDs and explicit branch joins. Resume an interrupted run after a worker restart.

tools.name: Deep Agents
tools.fit: A higher-level harness on LangGraph for planning, context offload and subagent delegation.
tools.tradeoff: File tools and shared memory widen the permissions surface.
tools.prompt: Give the research specialist a run-scoped workspace, read-only tools and bounded delegation.

tools.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
tools.fit: Lightweight agents, handoffs, tools and tracing for teams already using OpenAI integrations.
tools.tradeoff: Choose durable storage and an execution recovery strategy for long business processes.
tools.prompt: Define triage and specialist handoffs, narrow tool grants and a typed final output. Test provider timeout and replay.

tools.name: Vercel AI SDK
tools.fit: TypeScript model calls, tools and streaming for a bounded application agent.
tools.tradeoff: A tool loop still needs persistence, retry ownership and an explicit stopping policy.
tools.prompt: Use an allowlisted provider/model and typed tools. Bound steps, elapsed time and spend.

tools.name: Mastra
tools.fit: Integrated TypeScript agents and explicit workflows for a Node team.
tools.tradeoff: Evaluate the hosting adapter, persistence and upgrade path together.
tools.prompt: Define a typed workflow with an evidence step and suspended review, then prove resume after redeploy.

tools.name: Pydantic AI
tools.fit: Typed Python dependencies and outputs for model-assisted domain workflows.
tools.tradeoff: Structured output can still be factually wrong. Track outcome quality on real examples.
tools.prompt: Return a typed recommendation with evidence IDs, verify those IDs and score support for each claim.

tools.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
tools.fit: .NET and Python agent workflows for Microsoft-platform teams and existing Semantic Kernel or AutoGen estates.
tools.tradeoff: Migration and feature support differ by language and connector.
tools.prompt: Use the supported workflow primitives in one language. Pin connector versions and test checkpoint recovery.

tools.name: Google ADK
tools.fit: Agents, tools and workflow composition for teams using the Google agent ecosystem.
tools.tradeoff: Check session persistence, identity propagation and host-specific behavior.
tools.prompt: Give each specialist a bounded toolset and persist sessions in the approved regional service.

tools.name: Claude Agent SDK
tools.fit: Tool-capable Claude agents for research, document work and controlled coding workflows.
tools.tradeoff: Permission mode, tool allowlists, execution environment and credentials need deliberate ownership.
tools.prompt: Give one worker an isolated workspace and approved read tools. Capture artifact references and redact traces.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tools.fit: Choose a managed agent harness or host your own agent code in AgentCore Runtime.
tools.tradeoff: The managed harness and runtime expose different control points. Check regional availability by service.
tools.prompt: Document which layer owns the loop, where sessions live and how tool calls inherit scoped identity.

tools.name: MCP
tools.fit: Standard interface for tool and resource servers shared across clients.
tools.tradeoff: Protocol compatibility and tool discovery do not establish tenant or action authority.
tools.prompt: Pin a protocol revision, verify server identity, allowlist tools, and bind credentials to the tenant.

tools.name: A2A
tools.fit: Interoperability between independently deployed agents with task lifecycles.
tools.tradeoff: In-process specialists rarely justify protocol negotiation or remote identity overhead.
tools.prompt: Use it only across a real service boundary. Validate agent identity, capabilities, timeouts and artifacts.

tools.name: Vercel AI Gateway
tools.fit: Managed routing across model providers behind one gateway.
tools.tradeoff: Fallback can change region, data policy, model behavior and cost.
tools.prompt: Allowlist eligible fallback providers per data class and record the actual provider and model per call.

tools.name: LiteLLM
tools.fit: Gateway/proxy with a common model interface for a team operating its own routing layer.
tools.tradeoff: You own the proxy's availability, upgrades, keys and policy.
tools.prompt: Assign virtual credentials by application and tenant. Reject unapproved fallbacks and log attributed spend.

tools.name: Vercel Sandbox
tools.fit: Isolated compute for an agent that genuinely needs to execute generated code.
tools.tradeoff: Bound network, lifetime, artifacts and credential exposure per execution.
tools.prompt: Start a short-lived sandbox with scoped inputs. Copy approved artifacts out, then expire the environment.

tools.name: E2B
tools.fit: Independent sandbox service for model-generated code or data analysis.
tools.tradeoff: Evaluate image lineage, region, egress controls and session cleanup.
tools.prompt: Use a prepared image, minimal file mounts, bounded time and an audited artifact-export path.

tools.name: Temporal
tools.fit: Durable business workflows spanning outages, external systems and long human waits.
tools.tradeoff: Deterministic workflow code, activity idempotency and worker versioning are operational commitments.
tools.prompt: Make Temporal the workflow owner. Put all network and model calls into bounded activities.

tools.name: Inngest
tools.fit: Event-triggered durable steps and background work for application teams.
tools.tradeoff: Choose a single retry owner per side effect. Test event re-delivery and concurrency limits.
tools.prompt: Give each step a stable name and each logical effect a deduplication key. Exercise a duplicate trigger.

tools.name: Workflow SDK
tools.fit: Durable TypeScript functions and steps, including the execution substrate used by eve.
tools.tradeoff: Check upgrade, retention and deployment adapter behavior for the chosen host.
tools.prompt: Persist run references and use durable waits for review. If using eve, keep approvals in its owning workflow.

tools.name: FastAPI
tools.fit: Typed HTTP boundary for a Python agent or retrieval service.
tools.tradeoff: Long work in a request handler consumes capacity and is vulnerable to disconnects.
tools.prompt: Return 202 with a run ID, validate scope, enqueue durably, and expose a cursor-based event endpoint.

tools.name: NestJS
tools.fit: Structured Node API with modules and dependency injection for larger backend teams.
tools.tradeoff: A separate API service adds deployment and tracing overhead.
tools.prompt: Organize by case, approval and execution modules and validate inputs at each external boundary.

tools.name: OpenAPI
tools.fit: Describe HTTP endpoints and generate consistent clients for UI and integrations.
tools.tradeoff: Breaking response changes need compatibility and contract tests.
tools.prompt: Specify Run, Evidence, Approval and Problem responses. Include 403, 409 and idempotent retry examples.

tools.name: AsyncAPI
tools.fit: Document event channels, payloads and producer/consumer contracts across teams.
tools.tradeoff: A specification cannot enforce delivery order or deduplication.
tools.prompt: Publish event versions, delivery guarantees and per-run ordering. Reject unknown breaking versions.

tools.name: C4 model
tools.fit: Architecture notation for context, containers and component ownership.
tools.tradeoff: Dense component diagrams obscure operational boundaries.
tools.prompt: Draw browser, BFF, worker, database, IdP and model boundary. Label the owner and protocol of each crossing.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.fit: System of record for tenants, runs, approvals, events and effect receipts with row-level policies.
tools.tradeoff: Table owners and BYPASSRLS roles can bypass policies. Model worker privileges explicitly.
tools.prompt: Enable tenant policies and use scoped roles. Test cross-tenant access on the API, event stream and evidence.

tools.name: Drizzle ORM
tools.fit: Typed SQL access and migrations for a TypeScript/Postgres application.
tools.tradeoff: Migration lock time and RLS behavior still need database-level testing.
tools.prompt: Use reviewed migrations and verify a least-privilege application role on a restored production-sized database.

tools.name: pgvector
tools.fit: Vector retrieval beside relational metadata when Postgres already stores your knowledge base.
tools.tradeoff: Approximate retrieval under restrictive filters can hurt recall. Evaluate tenant-specific queries.
tools.prompt: Apply document ACLs and tenant filters, measure recall at k and cite stable chunk IDs.

tools.name: NATS JetStream
tools.fit: Persistent streams when several workers or independent consumers must replay domain events.
tools.tradeoff: At-least-once scenarios require consumer deduplication and capacity planning.
tools.prompt: Set explicit retention, ack policy and consumer lag alarms. Keep the authoritative run sequence in the store.

tools.name: Amazon S3
tools.fit: Object storage for large evidence files and exported artifacts.
tools.tradeoff: Signed URLs are bearer access. Decide expiry, retention, region and versioning.
tools.prompt: Store opaque object references in events and mint short-lived downloads after authorization.

tools.name: Transactional outbox
tools.fit: Commit a domain change and its pending message in the same database transaction.
tools.tradeoff: Dispatch can deliver duplicates. Consumers must tolerate retries.
tools.prompt: Insert the run and outbox record atomically, publish after commit, and reconcile unacknowledged messages.

tools.name: Server-sent events
tools.fit: One-way browser delivery of ordered run updates alongside ordinary HTTP commands.
tools.tradeoff: Connection limits, proxy buffering and cursor gaps vary by host.
tools.prompt: Send event IDs, heartbeat, resume cursor and snapshot fallback. Recheck authorization on reconnect.

tools.name: OpenTofu
tools.fit: Versioned infrastructure for repeatable private-network or enterprise deployments.
tools.tradeoff: Remote state is sensitive and needs restricted access and locking.
tools.prompt: Provision separate stage and production with encrypted state and reviewed plans.

tools.name: GitHub Actions OIDC
tools.fit: Short-lived cloud credentials for build and deployment jobs.
tools.tradeoff: Overbroad trust conditions can grant credentials to unintended jobs.
tools.prompt: Restrict trust to the correct repository, workflow/environment and audience. Pin third-party actions.

tools.name: OpenFeature
tools.fit: Vendor-neutral flag evaluation for progressive rollout and a circuit-breaking product switch.
tools.tradeoff: Flag evaluation must have a safe default when the provider fails.
tools.prompt: Gate the new harness version by tenant cohort, record the variant on every run, and support rollback.

tools.name: Storybook
tools.fit: Isolated component states, interaction stories and design review.
tools.tradeoff: A story can hide backend and reconnect failures. Pair it with a browser integration test.
tools.prompt: Create an approval story for pending, expired, rejected and already handled states.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.fit: Browser verification across run creation, review and reconnection.
tools.tradeoff: Time-based sleeps make event-driven tests brittle.
tools.prompt: Wait for event-derived UI states and assert the same run after reload. Capture traces on failure.

tools.name: axe-core for Playwright
tools.fit: Automated accessibility checks within exercised screens.
tools.tradeoff: Manual keyboard, screen reader, zoom and RTL testing remain necessary.
tools.prompt: Check the dialog open state and completed trace, then manually verify focus return and a nonvisual handoff.

tools.name: Grafana k6
tools.fit: Load testing APIs, streams and queues against explicit workload assumptions.
tools.tradeoff: Synthetic throughput without a representative tenant mix is misleading.
tools.prompt: Test bursts from one tenant while measuring another tenant's admission latency and run completion.

tools.name: OpenTelemetry
tools.fit: Correlated traces, metrics and logs across BFF, workflow and model gateway.
tools.tradeoff: Avoid tenant IDs in unbounded metric labels and scrub sensitive span attributes.
tools.prompt: Propagate trace context across queues. Record wait, tool time and model time as separate spans.

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.fit: Agent traces, prompt versions, datasets and evaluation results.
tools.tradeoff: Model inputs, outputs and traces can be sensitive. Configure sampling, redaction and retention.
tools.prompt: Tag each result with workflow, prompt, model and dataset version. Compare cost per successful case.

tools.name: Promptfoo
tools.fit: Repeatable evaluation suites comparing prompts, providers and application outcomes.
tools.tradeoff: Model-judged scores need human calibration. Keep deterministic controls separate.
tools.prompt: Evaluate route, tool allowlist and evidence correctness against labeled cases and output a CI report.

tools.name: OpenID Connect
tools.fit: Federated identity for enterprise login through the organization's identity provider.
tools.tradeoff: Identity alone does not authorize access to a tenant's records.
tools.prompt: Validate issuer and audience, map tenant membership server-side, and renew the session on sensitive decisions.

tools.name: Keycloak
tools.fit: Self-managed identity and federation for teams with the operational capacity.
tools.tradeoff: Owning the IdP adds patching, availability and recovery obligations.
tools.prompt: Integrate a separate test realm and exercise role withdrawal, session expiry and logout propagation.

tools.name: OpenFGA
tools.fit: Relationship-based checks for shared cases, delegated reviewers and hierarchical access.
tools.tradeoff: Relationship writes and caching introduce consistency questions at revocation.
tools.prompt: Represent reviewer and viewer relationships on cases. Recheck write permission immediately before execution.

tools.name: Open Policy Agent
tools.fit: Contextual policy decisions outside model prompts and application conditionals.
tools.tradeoff: Policy distribution, decision logging and fail-closed behavior need owners.
tools.prompt: Gate tool invocation using subject, tenant, action, resource and approval state. Persist the policy version.

tools.name: Vault
tools.fit: Central secrets management where teams need scoped credentials and rotation.
tools.tradeoff: Plan how workloads authenticate, renew leases and behave during an outage.
tools.prompt: Use workload identity to retrieve scoped secrets. Never pass raw secrets through prompts or user traces.

tools.name: OWASP ASVS
tools.fit: Verification requirements for prioritizing application security controls and tests.
tools.tradeoff: A checklist needs traceable evidence, applicability and ownership.
tools.prompt: Map applicable requirements to tests, evidence links and accountable owners for this app.

tools.name: OWASP agentic and GenAI guidance
tools.fit: Threat categories for agent tools, autonomy, identities and delegated work.
tools.tradeoff: Pair threat descriptions with preventive controls and release evidence.
tools.prompt: Threat-model untrusted retrieved content, excessive agency and over-scoped access. Test the intended denial paths.

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.fit: Static analysis for unsafe patterns in generated and handwritten source.
tools.tradeoff: Rules need tuning and owners to prevent high-noise gates.
tools.prompt: Review new high-confidence findings on changed code and record time-limited, owned exceptions.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.fit: Scan built artifacts and infrastructure configuration for known issues.
tools.tradeoff: Scan results depend on advisory freshness, artifact scope and configuration.
tools.prompt: Scan the release image digest and IaC, record the scanner database time and triage actionable findings.

tools.name: CycloneDX
tools.fit: Standard bill-of-materials format for dependencies and shipped artifacts.
tools.tradeoff: Generating an SBOM does not prove the release came from the trusted build.
tools.prompt: Attach an SBOM to the release digest and verify it identifies the dependencies actually shipped.

tools.name: Sigstore Cosign
tools.fit: Sign and verify artifact identity and attestations in the release pipeline.
tools.tradeoff: A valid signature still needs a trusted issuer and expected signing identity.
tools.prompt: At deployment verify the artifact digest, expected workflow identity and issuer before promotion.

tools.name: SLSA
tools.fit: Supply-chain framework for evaluating build provenance and integrity.
tools.tradeoff: Choose a target level and verify its actual requirements before making assurance claims.
tools.prompt: Record source revision, builder identity and provenance verification alongside each release.

tools.name: Anime.js
tools.fit: SVG path drawing, morphing and object-on-path motion for custom diagrams.
tools.tradeoff: Choose it for a bespoke diagram with a defined DOM owner. Avoid two animation engines writing the same property.
tools.prompt: Animate a single envelope along the committed edge and clear it on completion or seek.

tools.name: Web Animations API
tools.fit: Native browser animation control for simple transitions and playback using a small dependency budget.
tools.tradeoff: A path layout, timeline model and React lifecycle cleanup are your responsibility.
tools.prompt: Animate the committed handoff in the browser and cancel the animation when the view unmounts or the cursor jumps.

tools.name: D3 transitions
tools.fit: Data joins and interpolated transitions for custom span waterfalls, distribution views and changing metrics.
tools.tradeoff: Give D3 ownership of a bounded rendering subtree and stable span keys.
tools.prompt: Build a duration waterfall keyed by span ID, preserve row order and update only the bars whose timestamps changed.

tools.name: PixiJS
tools.fit: A GPU-backed overlay for many simultaneous packet sprites or dense telemetry visuals.
tools.tradeoff: Profile first. Use an accessible DOM inspector and keep GPU coordinates in sync with pan and zoom.
tools.prompt: Render only visible, sampled transfer sprites; pause the ticker in background tabs and retain exact counts in the event list.

tools.name: Sigma.js
tools.fit: WebGL network exploration when the problem is a large network of relationships.
tools.tradeoff: Rich editable HTML nodes and form-heavy operator workflows favor a different renderer.
tools.prompt: Map the service dependency network at overview zoom and drill into one run for its exact sequence and decisions.

tools.name: dotLottie-web
tools.fit: Playback of authored vector motion assets for reusable illustrations and state cues.
tools.tradeoff: An asset alone cannot encode changing topology, payloads or audit semantics.
tools.prompt: Bind a short completion or fault asset to a committed state. Preserve visible status text and offer a still frame.

tools.name: SvelteKit
tools.fit: Server-rendered Svelte workspaces with forms and per-route loading.
tools.tradeoff: Choose the deployment adapter early; streaming and server capabilities depend on the host.
tools.prompt: Enhance a case form progressively, then test it with JavaScript disabled and with a validation error.

tools.name: Astro
tools.fit: A content-heavy documentation estate with occasional interactive components.
tools.tradeoff: Hydrating every island gives away the lightweight delivery advantage.
tools.prompt: Render reference pages as static HTML and hydrate only the diagram inspector.

tools.name: TanStack Router
tools.fit: Type-safe routing and shareable filter state in a React SPA.
tools.tradeoff: The team owns the API and server-rendering integration it selects.
tools.prompt: Represent queue filters and selected case as validated search parameters. Test a copied deep link.

tools.name: Ant Design
tools.fit: Dense business forms and administration workflows for a React team.
tools.tradeoff: Translating a bespoke brand into the component system takes design ownership.
tools.prompt: Specify table density, field validation, empty states and locale formatting in one theme.

tools.name: Fluent UI
tools.fit: An application that needs to feel familiar in the Microsoft ecosystem.
tools.tradeoff: Check component coverage separately across React and web-component implementations.
tools.prompt: Use the native Fluent patterns for task navigation, commands and contextual detail.

tools.name: Spectrum
tools.fit: An established design language with detailed interaction and accessibility guidance.
tools.tradeoff: Design guidance and the chosen React implementation can differ in coverage.
tools.prompt: Map date, selection and error semantics to the matching implementation before committing the design.

tools.name: PatternFly
tools.fit: Platform administration, cluster operations and dense resource inventory.
tools.tradeoff: A mature admin vocabulary can still need domain-specific content and navigation.
tools.prompt: Give resource status, namespace and last observed time separate fields in the inventory.

tools.name: USWDS
tools.fit: Public-service experiences needing clear forms and accessible layout guidance.
tools.tradeoff: Check the service's own accessibility, language and brand obligations.
tools.prompt: Use one question per decision and show corrective text that identifies the field and recovery action.

tools.name: GOV.UK Design System
tools.fit: Transactional services involving eligibility, application, review and confirmation.
tools.tradeoff: Adapt local policy and language and retain the user's own visual identity.
tools.prompt: Use a check-answers pattern before submission and a confirmation reference afterwards.

tools.name: Floating UI
tools.fit: Positioning an anchored inspector, tooltip or contextual menu in complex layouts.
tools.tradeoff: Positioning alone does not supply dialog semantics or a focus policy.
tools.prompt: Keep the inspector visible near the selected item on scroll and test Escape and focus return.

tools.name: Ariakit
tools.fit: A custom React design system with accessible menu, combobox and dialog behavior.
tools.tradeoff: Visual treatment, integration testing and component composition are team responsibilities.
tools.prompt: Test a long combobox with a keyboard, a screen reader and an input-method editor.

tools.name: Headless UI
tools.fit: Unstyled accessible components for an existing Tailwind-based interface.
tools.tradeoff: Avoid mixing separate overlay stacks across teams without a shared focus contract.
tools.prompt: Use the dialog primitive for review and restore focus to the invoking queue action.

tools.name: Recharts
tools.fit: Conventional React dashboards with composable Cartesian charts.
tools.tradeoff: High mark counts and bespoke interactions need device-level profiling.
tools.prompt: Plot queue age and tool latency on separate charts with labeled units and a table alternative.

tools.name: Observable Plot
tools.fit: Exploratory operational charts where a concise statistical grammar is valuable.
tools.tradeoff: Product-level interaction and persistent selection need surrounding state management.
tools.prompt: Facet queue delay by region and include sample size for each distribution.

tools.name: Vega-Lite
tools.fit: Reusable declarative chart specs for linked operational analytics.
tools.tradeoff: A generated chart specification still needs schema, dataset and URL restrictions.
tools.prompt: Allow an approved chart schema and a bounded field catalog; fail gracefully on invalid encodings.

tools.name: Cytoscape.js
tools.fit: Network analysis and graph selection where topology matters more than form-like nodes.
tools.tradeoff: Interactive complexity, layout cost and accessibility need separate design.
tools.prompt: Filter services by neighborhood and link selected nodes to an equivalent textual dependency view.

tools.name: Graphviz
tools.fit: Reproducible static architecture and dependency diagrams from structured topology.
tools.tradeoff: Large diagrams can become illegible despite automatic layout.
tools.prompt: Split trust boundaries and runtime flows across diagrams. Label edge direction and protocol.

tools.name: Mermaid
tools.fit: Maintaining architecture, state and sequence diagrams beside design decisions.
tools.tradeoff: Renderer capabilities differ between documentation hosts.
tools.prompt: Use stable names and one decision per diagram. Verify rendering on the publishing target.

tools.name: visx
tools.fit: Bespoke React visualizations requiring control over scales and marks.
tools.tradeoff: The team owns axes, legends, keyboard navigation and accessible explanations.
tools.prompt: Build a tool-span waterfall with consistent time scales and links to textual span details.

tools.name: Konva
tools.fit: A canvas-based floor plan, equipment editor or layered inspection surface.
tools.tradeoff: A canvas needs a parallel semantic interaction path and explicit hit testing.
tools.prompt: Synchronize canvas selection with a keyboard-accessible equipment list.

tools.name: Three.js
tools.fit: A 3D inspection where orientation or occlusion changes an operator's decision.
tools.tradeoff: Asset budget, GPU availability and camera controls affect actual usability.
tools.prompt: Define the inspection question, lazy-load the model and provide a labeled 2D fallback.

tools.name: View Transition API
tools.fit: Shared visual continuity between a list item and its detail screen.
tools.tradeoff: Check platform support and avoid two engines animating the same element.
tools.prompt: Provide a plain navigation path and honor reduced motion when transitioning between case and detail.

tools.name: FormatJS
tools.fit: Localized messages, plural forms and dates for internationalized web applications.
tools.tradeoff: Extracted keys and translations require an ownership and release workflow.
tools.prompt: Format numeric counts by locale and keep opaque case identifiers untranslated.

tools.name: i18next
tools.fit: Runtime locale selection and resource namespaces across multiple clients.
tools.tradeoff: Lazy-loaded namespaces can produce partial screens or fallback leaks.
tools.prompt: Test a missing translation and language switch in the middle of an approval journey.

tools.name: Style Dictionary
tools.fit: Distributing design tokens to several web and native clients.
tools.tradeoff: Build transforms can diverge by platform or silently change token meaning.
tools.prompt: Produce light, dark and high-contrast outputs from semantic aliases and review visual diffs.

tools.name: Design Tokens Community Group format
tools.fit: A portable token exchange format between design tools and platform builds.
tools.tradeoff: Validate tool support for the selected specification revision and alias behavior.
tools.prompt: Specify semantic color and motion tokens once and validate aliases before generating platform values.

tools.name: Kafka
tools.fit: A durable event backbone for independent consumers and replayable streams.
tools.tradeoff: Partitioning defines ordering scope; slow consumers and schema drift require operational tooling.
tools.prompt: Key events by aggregate ID, version payloads and expose consumer lag and replay controls.

tools.name: RabbitMQ
tools.fit: Work queues and routing where acknowledgment and delivery behavior are explicit.
tools.tradeoff: A retry can redeliver work already applied at the destination.
tools.prompt: Declare queue ownership, retry deadlines, dead-letter routing and an idempotent consumer.

tools.name: Apache Flink
tools.fit: Stateful stream processing for time-windowed telemetry and late events.
tools.tradeoff: State size, watermark strategy and checkpoint recovery need load tests.
tools.prompt: Define event time, allowed lateness and the correction rule for an updated metric.

tools.name: Debezium
tools.fit: Change-data capture for downstream projections and integration feeds.
tools.tradeoff: Schema evolution, initial snapshots and retained transaction logs require ownership.
tools.prompt: Specify a bootstrap snapshot, durable offsets and recovery when a consumer falls behind retention.

tools.name: Redis
tools.fit: Low-latency cache and short-lived counters for an existing application.
tools.tradeoff: Eviction, failover and stale authorization can change business behavior.
tools.prompt: Scope cache keys to tenant and permission version. Test eviction and database fallback.

tools.name: Valkey
tools.fit: An open-source key-value service where a managed or self-hosted deployment is needed.
tools.tradeoff: Verify client, command and service compatibility with the workload.
tools.prompt: Set TTL and memory policy per use case and test read behavior during failover.

tools.name: ClickHouse
tools.fit: Analytical scans across append-heavy events, traces or telemetry.
tools.tradeoff: Table order and ingestion shape drive query cost and correction behavior.
tools.prompt: Model the primary time and tenant filters and benchmark the p95 dashboard query on production-shaped data.

tools.name: DuckDB
tools.fit: Embedded analytics over columnar files for reproducible investigations.
tools.tradeoff: Concurrency and memory budgets differ from a shared analytical service.
tools.prompt: Analyze a versioned Parquet snapshot and report sampling, filters and query time.

tools.name: OpenSearch
tools.fit: Search across indexed enterprise documents with filters and aggregations.
tools.tradeoff: Index freshness and authorization propagation need explicit service objectives.
tools.prompt: Apply tenant and document grants, record source revisions and test revoked-document search.

tools.name: Qdrant
tools.fit: A dedicated vector retrieval service for filtered semantic search.
tools.tradeoff: Choosing an index, embedding revision and filter strategy requires a labeled retrieval set.
tools.prompt: Benchmark recall and latency with restrictive tenant filters and realistic deletion frequency.

tools.name: Apache Iceberg
tools.fit: Large analytical tables that need snapshot history and schema evolution.
tools.tradeoff: Catalog maintenance, compaction and expired snapshot cleanup have a cost.
tools.prompt: Version the event schema and define the retention and compaction policy for archived runs.

tools.name: gRPC
tools.fit: Typed internal service calls and streaming across service boundaries.
tools.tradeoff: Browser and proxy compatibility need a deliberate gateway or transport choice.
tools.prompt: Set deadlines and cancellation, version protobuf fields compatibly and test service degradation.

tools.name: GraphQL
tools.fit: Multiple clients need different shapes of a shared domain graph.
tools.tradeoff: Resolver authorization, query cost and per-field fan-out need controls.
tools.prompt: Cap complexity and verify field-level authorization on sensitive case relationships.

tools.name: CloudEvents
tools.fit: A common envelope across event producers and transport adapters.
tools.tradeoff: Domain schemas, delivery guarantees and tenant permissions remain application decisions.
tools.prompt: Keep source, type, ID and payload schema stable across broker and HTTP transports.

tools.name: JSON Schema
tools.fit: Validating data at HTTP, workflow, tool and event boundaries.
tools.tradeoff: Draft support and allowed keywords vary across validators and model providers.
tools.prompt: Pin the dialect and reject unknown action types before a tool receives arguments.

tools.name: Kubernetes
tools.fit: A platform team needs scheduling, rollout and isolation controls for many services.
tools.tradeoff: Operational overhead is substantial for a small service or simple website.
tools.prompt: Specify resource requests, disruption budgets and worker drain behavior before choosing the cluster shape.

tools.name: Argo CD
tools.fit: Declarative application delivery from Git for Kubernetes environments.
tools.tradeoff: Separately authorize repository writes, deployment promotion and secret access.
tools.prompt: Show drift, require production promotion review and rehearse rollback of a worker revision.

tools.name: Helm
tools.fit: Packaging and configuring versioned Kubernetes applications.
tools.tradeoff: Template complexity can hide environment-specific mistakes.
tools.prompt: Render and check the production values in CI and document data migration dependencies.

tools.name: Envoy
tools.fit: Consistent edge or service-proxy behavior across a polyglot estate.
tools.tradeoff: Timeout and retry policies can amplify work when also configured upstream.
tools.prompt: Assign retry ownership and measure the effective end-to-end request deadline.

tools.name: Dapr
tools.fit: Common building blocks for services across different language runtimes.
tools.tradeoff: Sidecar dependencies introduce another version, latency and recovery boundary.
tools.prompt: Specify which pub/sub or state component is used and test its actual delivery semantics.

tools.name: Backstage
tools.fit: A developer portal for service ownership, documentation and templates.
tools.tradeoff: Catalog accuracy needs integration with engineering ownership practices.
tools.prompt: Expose the team's runbook, service owner, SLO and escalation path on one catalog record.

tools.name: OpenAPI Generator
tools.fit: Repeatable client generation for multiple API consumers.
tools.tradeoff: Generator changes and hand edits create drift.
tools.prompt: Pin the generator and schema revision and verify an older client against the new server.

tools.name: LlamaIndex
tools.fit: Ingestion and retrieval components for evidence-backed domain assistants.
tools.tradeoff: A retrieval pipeline needs independent ACL enforcement and citation evaluation.
tools.prompt: Link every returned chunk to its authorized source revision and measure recall.

tools.name: Haystack
tools.fit: Explicit search and generation pipelines with swappable components.
tools.tradeoff: Pipeline flexibility can complicate component-level performance attribution.
tools.prompt: Benchmark retrieval, reranking and generation independently against a fixed query set.

tools.name: DSPy
tools.fit: Optimizing typed language-model programs against a defined metric and examples.
tools.tradeoff: An optimizer can improve a proxy metric while worsening a business outcome.
tools.prompt: Use separate training and held-out sets and inspect failure slices before promoting the candidate.

tools.name: CrewAI
tools.fit: Role-based multi-agent coordination with explicit tasks and process choices.
tools.tradeoff: More roles can add repeated work and compound cost.
tools.prompt: Compare two specialists against a single-agent baseline and cap delegation depth.

tools.name: Strands Agents
tools.fit: Model-driven agents with composable tools for teams working in the AWS ecosystem.
tools.tradeoff: Model-directed tools still need scoped credentials and explicit stop conditions.
tools.prompt: Document the agent loop, model boundary, permitted tools and receipt requirements.

tools.name: Semantic Kernel
tools.fit: An installed Microsoft agent or plugin estate requiring maintenance or migration analysis.
tools.tradeoff: Review the Microsoft Agent Framework migration path for new investment.
tools.prompt: Inventory existing plugins, memory and workflows and test the target equivalent on representative cases.

tools.name: Model Context Protocol Apps
tools.fit: Interactive resources served from a tool experience to a compatible host.
tools.tradeoff: Host support, isolation, authentication and renderer behavior need verification.
tools.prompt: Define allowed UI actions and a text-only fallback for clients without the extension.

tools.name: OpenAI Responses API
tools.fit: Applications using OpenAI tools, structured responses and multi-step interactions.
tools.tradeoff: Available tools and retention controls depend on model, account and configuration.
tools.prompt: Map tool call and result identifiers to the business run without exposing provider secrets.

tools.name: Claude Messages API
tools.fit: Applications invoking Claude with typed content blocks and tools.
tools.tradeoff: The client has to handle tool responses, continuation, failures and output validation.
tools.prompt: Record the stop reason, validate each tool request and return a scoped tool result.

tools.name: Cloudflare Workflows
tools.fit: Durable execution aligned with a Workers deployment.
tools.tradeoff: Review current step limits, retention and supported runtimes.
tools.prompt: Suspend the workflow at a human wait and prove a worker redeploy preserves the pending decision.

tools.name: AWS Step Functions
tools.fit: AWS-native state machines coordinating managed services and business activities.
tools.tradeoff: Choose workflow type and cost model for the actual duration and volume.
tools.prompt: Model retries, timeouts, explicit compensation and correlation to the business case.

tools.name: Azure Durable Functions
tools.fit: Durable orchestration and external events in an Azure Functions estate.
tools.tradeoff: Orchestrator replay constrains code and requires careful versioning.
tools.prompt: Put non-deterministic I/O in activities and test an old approval after a new deployment.

tools.name: Restate
tools.fit: Durable service invocation and stateful workflows with explicit service boundaries.
tools.tradeoff: Service-side durability does not make a non-idempotent external action safe.
tools.prompt: Use a stable logical effect ID and reconcile destination receipts across retries.

tools.name: Vitest
tools.fit: Fast unit and component-level checks for Vite-oriented applications.
tools.tradeoff: Mocked tests alone cannot verify browser semantics or actual deployments.
tools.prompt: Test the event reducer against duplicates, gaps, terminal transitions and cursor rewind.

tools.name: Testing Library
tools.fit: User-oriented component tests written against accessible roles and names.
tools.tradeoff: An accessible query passing still leaves full keyboard and screen-reader journeys to verify.
tools.prompt: Select by role, submit an invalid field and verify the visible recovery message.

tools.name: Mock Service Worker
tools.fit: Reproducible request-level behavior for integration tests and component stories.
tools.tradeoff: Keep mocks synchronized with the real API contract.
tools.prompt: Model delayed responses, a denied decision and a stale version using the published schema.

tools.name: Pact
tools.fit: Consumer-driven integration contracts between independently released services.
tools.tradeoff: A contract test covers interactions represented by the consumer and provider suites.
tools.prompt: Verify both last production consumer and next consumer contracts before promoting the provider.

tools.name: Lighthouse
tools.fit: Repeatable lab audits of representative pages and constrained device profiles.
tools.tradeoff: A one-off lab score cannot stand in for field measurements or manual accessibility review.
tools.prompt: Run the same authenticated task on every candidate and investigate the largest regression.

tools.name: web-vitals
tools.fit: Measuring user-centric performance in real browser sessions.
tools.tradeoff: Sampling and device mix can hide regressions for an important cohort.
tools.prompt: Compare p75 responsiveness by route, device class and release cohort with privacy-safe labels.

tools.name: Jaeger
tools.fit: Distributed trace exploration for causality, overlapping spans and service latency.
tools.tradeoff: Sampled traces leave gaps in authoritative business history.
tools.prompt: Link a run to its trace and distinguish active tool time, queue delay and human wait.

tools.name: Prometheus
tools.fit: Time-series monitoring and alerts for capacity, rates and saturation.
tools.tradeoff: High-cardinality identifiers multiply storage and query cost.
tools.prompt: Track bounded dimensions on admission, queue age and outcomes. Keep per-case IDs in traces.

tools.name: Grafana Tempo
tools.fit: A trace backend integrated with dashboards and telemetry pipelines.
tools.tradeoff: Storage, sampling and sensitive attributes require deliberate governance.
tools.prompt: Find a slow run from a metric exemplar and inspect linked tool and worker spans.

tools.name: Sentry
tools.fit: Application errors, release regressions and related performance symptoms.
tools.tradeoff: Configure scrubbing and consent before collecting sensitive context or replay.
tools.prompt: Attach a safe release tag and route name to an error, then verify source maps and redaction.

tools.name: Arize Phoenix
tools.fit: Open-source tracing and evaluation for LLM and retrieval workflows.
tools.tradeoff: Trace visibility requires privacy controls and calibrated human labels.
tools.prompt: Compare groundedness and tool success by model, dataset version and retrieval strategy.

tools.name: Ragas
tools.fit: Evaluations of retrieval-augmented answers and evidence quality.
tools.tradeoff: Judge-model scores can be biased or unstable across upgrades.
tools.prompt: Hold evidence fixed, calibrate against human labels and report disagreement on hard examples.

tools.name: OpenLLMetry
tools.fit: LLM-specific instrumentation layered onto OpenTelemetry export pipelines.
tools.tradeoff: Instrumentation can capture sensitive request or response content if left unchecked.
tools.prompt: Define the content capture policy and verify a synthetic sensitive marker never reaches the exporter.

tools.name: Great Expectations
tools.fit: Checking batch or analytical data assumptions before dependent workflows consume it.
tools.tradeoff: Freshness, business validity and expectation ownership still need agreement.
tools.prompt: Quarantine an invalid batch, record the failing expectation and preserve last-known-good data.

tools.name: OpenSLO
tools.fit: A portable way to express service-level objectives and their indicators.
tools.tradeoff: Backend capabilities and alert translation need testing in the actual monitoring system.
tools.prompt: Define admission latency and successful completion as separate SLIs with agreed measurement windows.

tools.name: OAuth 2.0 Security BCP
tools.fit: A current baseline for evaluating delegated authorization flows and client behavior.
tools.tradeoff: Map the recommendations to your client type, identity provider and supported flows.
tools.prompt: Document redirect validation, token audience, PKCE and token storage for the selected client.

tools.name: WebAuthn
tools.fit: Public-key credentials for user authentication, including passkey-capable journeys.
tools.tradeoff: Enrollment, recovery, device availability and accessibility affect adoption.
tools.prompt: Design registration, sign-in, lost-device recovery and fallback ownership as one journey.

tools.name: SCIM
tools.fit: Tenant provisioning and deprovisioning between an enterprise IdP and SaaS.
tools.tradeoff: Sync lag and group mappings complicate immediate access revocation.
tools.prompt: Show how disabling a directory account revokes active access and queued approvals.

tools.name: SPIFFE
tools.fit: Portable workload identity across service boundaries.
tools.tradeoff: A trust domain and attestation policy require an operating owner.
tools.prompt: Name each worker identity and verify the audience and trust domain before granting a tool.

tools.name: SPIRE
tools.fit: Issuing and rotating identities for attested workloads in a SPIFFE deployment.
tools.tradeoff: Trust bootstrap and agent availability are infrastructure dependencies.
tools.prompt: Define node and workload attestation plus the behavior when identity renewal is unavailable.

tools.name: Cedar
tools.fit: Policy-as-code decisions using principals, actions, resources and context.
tools.tradeoff: The application must supply correct entities and enforce every decision.
tools.prompt: Evaluate a reviewer action against tenant, case, role and proposal revision immediately before the write.

tools.name: Zanzibar model
tools.fit: A reference design for relationship-based authorization at significant scale.
tools.tradeoff: Consistency after permission changes matters as much as relationship modeling.
tools.prompt: Explain revocation freshness and how nested membership is bounded and tested.

tools.name: OpenBao
tools.fit: Self-managed secret storage, dynamic credentials and leases where operational control is needed.
tools.tradeoff: Recovery, unsealing, availability and rotation require a named team.
tools.prompt: Describe workload login, scoped lease lifetime, revocation and an outage drill.

tools.name: Kyverno
tools.fit: Kubernetes admission and policy enforcement for cluster workloads.
tools.tradeoff: An overly broad policy can block legitimate deployments or create noisy exceptions.
tools.prompt: Start with an owned policy report, test known workloads and explicitly approve enforcement scope.

tools.name: Falco
tools.fit: Runtime event detection for containerized workloads and operating-system activity.
tools.tradeoff: High-volume alerts need tuning, correlation and an investigation owner.
tools.prompt: Map one approved detection to an incident runbook and measure false positives on normal batch jobs.

tools.name: Syft
tools.fit: Software bill of materials generation for built packages and images.
tools.tradeoff: Source and final-image inventories can differ.
tools.prompt: Generate an SBOM for the release digest and associate the artifact and build metadata.

tools.name: OSV-Scanner
tools.fit: Dependency vulnerability screening against machine-readable advisories.
tools.tradeoff: Reachability and business exposure still require triage.
tools.prompt: Record affected package, shipped artifact, advisory revision and the owner of a remediation decision.

tools.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
tools.fit: Comparing observable repository security practices before adopting a dependency.
tools.tradeoff: Scores can lag or misrepresent project context and are insufficient on their own.
tools.prompt: Review the underlying checks, maintainer activity, provenance and unresolved findings.

tools.name: NIST Zero Trust Architecture
tools.fit: A reference for resource-centric access decisions across users, devices and workloads.
tools.tradeoff: A design principle requires an inventory of resources, policy points and actual enforcement.
tools.prompt: Mark policy decision, enforcement, identity evidence and audit boundaries on the architecture diagram.

tools.name: OWASP SAMM
tools.fit: Assessing maturity and prioritizing improvements to a software security program.
tools.tradeoff: Maturity levels measure practices and require evidence from teams.
tools.prompt: Select an improvement under design, implementation or verification with owner, evidence and target date.

tools.name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
tools.fit: Practical defensive reference material for sessions, authorization, uploads and logging.
tools.tradeoff: Select guidance relevant to your stack and threat model.
tools.prompt: Map three concrete controls to their enforcement location and a non-destructive acceptance check.

tools.name: WCAG 2.2
tools.fit: Designing and evaluating accessible web content against defined success criteria.
tools.tradeoff: Conformance requires evaluation of actual journeys, components and supported technology.
tools.prompt: Specify keyboard completion, visible focus, input assistance, zoom and motion alternatives for the core task.

tools.name: ARIA APG
tools.fit: Established keyboard interaction and semantics for widgets such as dialogs, tabs and grids.
tools.tradeoff: Applying a role without its expected behavior can worsen accessibility.
tools.prompt: Compare the custom dialog against the APG keyboard and focus pattern with real assistive technology.

tools.name: WAI Easy Checks
tools.fit: An introductory review of headings, contrast, text alternatives and keyboard behavior.
tools.tradeoff: Preliminary checks cover only part of an accessibility evaluation.
tools.prompt: Use the easy checks for triage, then schedule deeper manual coverage of the critical task.

tools.name: GOV.UK Service Manual
tools.fit: Researching, designing, operating and measuring end-to-end transactional services.
tools.tradeoff: Adapt service ownership and channel assumptions to your organization.
tools.prompt: Map the customer's goal, assisted channel, operational dependency and service outcome.

tools.name: 18F Methods
tools.fit: Practical methods for discovery, synthesis, prototyping and evaluation.
tools.tradeoff: Choose the method around a decision and the evidence you need.
tools.prompt: Write a research question, recruitment criteria, session protocol and how the findings change a decision.

tools.name: HEART framework
tools.fit: Translating product goals into experience signals and metrics.
tools.tradeoff: A broad framework still needs a baseline, denominator and action threshold.
tools.prompt: Map onboarding success to observable task completion, repeat use and a countermetric for support burden.

tools.name: Nielsen usability heuristics
tools.fit: A structured expert review of visibility, control, errors and consistency.
tools.tradeoff: An expert critique cannot establish how frequently real users fail.
tools.prompt: Attach a screen, user task, severity rationale and a proposed validation method to every issue.

tools.name: Service blueprinting
tools.fit: Connecting customer actions to frontstage responses, backstage work and support systems.
tools.tradeoff: A blueprint needs owners and recovery paths at cross-team handoffs.
tools.prompt: Trace a missed appointment from customer notification through agent review to confirmed resolution.

tools.name: W3C internationalization
tools.fit: Guidance for language metadata, directionality, multilingual layout and text handling.
tools.tradeoff: Translation alone cannot establish bidirectional or locale behavior.
tools.prompt: Verify mixed Arabic text, Latin case IDs, numbers, dates and keyboard navigation in context.

tools.name: Microsoft Inclusive Design
tools.fit: Identifying mismatches between human abilities, context and product assumptions.
tools.tradeoff: The method works best with participation from people experiencing the exclusion.
tools.prompt: Recruit across permanent, temporary and situational constraints and retest the highest-friction task.

tools.name: PostHog
tools.fit: Connect invitation, first useful action and repeat use in an event funnel.
tools.tradeoff: Session replay can collect sensitive screen content. Decide which events the product needs and disable unnecessary capture.
tools.prompt: Draft an event dictionary for the booking funnel, including the server event that proves success.

tools.name: Amplitude
tools.fit: Investigate activation and retention across cohorts with a managed analytics platform.
tools.tradeoff: A change in event definitions can look like a change in customer behavior. Version definitions and compare both for an overlap period.
tools.prompt: Compare repeat bookings for two onboarding cohorts using a fixed inclusion rule.

tools.name: GrowthBook
tools.fit: Evaluate variants and analyze product experiments against warehouse data.
tools.tradeoff: Randomizing by user can mix experiences inside a shared customer account. Define the unit of assignment first.
tools.prompt: Design a tenant-level experiment with a primary outcome, guardrail and plan for small cohorts.

tools.name: Unleash
tools.fit: Roll a capability out to defined cohorts with centrally managed feature flags.
tools.tradeoff: Long-lived flags create untested combinations. Give each flag a removal date and an owner.
tools.prompt: Describe how to disable new booking proposals while settling existing ones.

tools.name: LaunchDarkly
tools.fit: Manage targeted releases and flag evaluation across multiple services.
tools.tradeoff: Plan for stale or unavailable configuration and confirm which controls your contract covers.
tools.prompt: Provide safe defaults for a new tenant and an unavailable flag service.

tools.name: OpenMeter
tools.fit: Meter usage against a product dimension such as completed operations per account.
tools.tradeoff: Usage records need stable subjects and event IDs. A technical retry should not become a second billable outcome.
tools.prompt: Model two tool attempts, one final receipt and the resulting usage record.

tools.name: FinOps FOCUS
tools.fit: Normalize supported billing data when comparing infrastructure or provider spend.
tools.tradeoff: A common cost schema cannot assign an invoice line to a customer outcome without an allocation key.
tools.prompt: Map eligible invoice fields to tenant and workload, and put unallocated cost in a visible bucket.

tools.name: FinOps unit economics
tools.fit: Define the business unit when reviewing model, infrastructure and human handling costs.
tools.tradeoff: A cheap completed call can belong to a case that never resolves. Count eligible cases and final outcomes separately.
tools.prompt: Compute cost per verified resolution for the baseline and the proposed pilot.

tools.name: GOV.UK Service Standard
tools.fit: Review whether a service solves a whole problem across channels and can be operated reliably.
tools.tradeoff: Applying the standard still requires user research and evidence from people operating the service.
tools.prompt: Trace a failed online booking into assisted support and back to a single case record.

tools.name: Google SRE Workbook on SLOs
tools.fit: Translate a customer promise into a measurable service-level objective and error budget.
tools.tradeoff: A fast API response can hide a long wait for the actual service outcome.
tools.prompt: Define good and eligible events for timely booking confirmation, and name the owner when the budget is exhausted.

tools.name: NIST AI RMF Playbook
tools.fit: Organize model-risk decisions, measurement and accountability across product stakeholders.
tools.tradeoff: The playbook supplies guidance. Approval, evidence and treatment of residual risk remain organizational decisions.
tools.prompt: Assign an accountable owner and measurable outcome to the three largest risks in the pilot.

tools.name: AWS SaaS Lens
tools.fit: Review tenant onboarding, isolation and tenant-aware operations in a SaaS architecture.
tools.tradeoff: Map the advice to your deployment and customer contracts, including where evidence lives.
tools.prompt: Walk a noisy tenant, a revoked tenant and a tenant export through the proposed service.

tools.name: Airbyte
tools.fit: Ingest operational records into an analytical store using source and destination connectors.
tools.tradeoff: Check incremental cursors, deletes and schema drift for each connector before trusting the copy.
tools.prompt: Reconcile a changed appointment, a deletion and two syncs that overlap.

tools.name: dbt
tools.fit: Transform analytical data into documented, testable models for product reporting.
tools.tradeoff: Late receipts change attribution. Version the metric and define when prior periods can be restated.
tools.prompt: Build a unique case-level result from attempts, receipts and support closures.

tools.name: OpenLineage
tools.fit: Describe lineage between jobs, runs and datasets across participating systems.
tools.tradeoff: Missing integrations leave gaps. Verify the path of a single record rather than assuming universal coverage.
tools.prompt: Map the sources behind a changed pilot metric and mark any uninstrumented hop.

tools.name: DataHub
tools.fit: Catalog datasets, ownership and lineage for discovery and governance.
tools.tradeoff: A stale owner or incomplete ingestion makes a search result misleading. Set a freshness expectation.
tools.prompt: Find the owner of the booking metric, its underlying data and the last successful ingestion.

tools.name: Flyway
tools.fit: Manage versioned relational database migrations with an established migration workflow.
tools.tradeoff: A migration history cannot make a destructive schema change reversible. Rehearse old-reader compatibility and restoration.
tools.prompt: Stage an additive receipt column, backfill it and verify that the prior app version still works.

tools.name: LangChain text splitters
tools.fit: Split long source documents before retrieval while retaining logical sections where possible.
tools.tradeoff: Overlapping chunks can inflate apparent recall. Score against unique source passages and revisions.
tools.prompt: Compare two chunking rules on the same policy questions and count distinct relevant passages.

tools.name: Docling
tools.fit: Parse structurally complex source documents for retrieval and inspection.
tools.tradeoff: Tables and scans need manual spot checks. Preserve document and page provenance through conversion.
tools.prompt: Show whether a fee and its exception remain linked after parsing the source table.

tools.name: vLLM
tools.fit: Serve supported model weights when a team owns inference deployment and capacity.
tools.tradeoff: Model license, hardware fit, idle capacity and operations can dominate the business case.
tools.prompt: Estimate the utilization at which a regional deployment beats the managed endpoint on cost per accepted task.

tools.name: DeepEval
tools.fit: Write LLM evaluation tests alongside Python development and CI workflows.
tools.tradeoff: Judge-based metrics need calibration. Keep deterministic checks for receipts and permissions.
tools.prompt: Report a grader disagreement and one policy violation separately from the mean answer score.

tools.name: Braintrust
tools.fit: Compare experiments on versioned datasets and examine individual cases and traces.
tools.tradeoff: Review retention and project access before sending production examples or prompts.
tools.prompt: Compare the same 20 redacted cases and show the three outcomes that changed the release decision.

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.fit: Inspect traced executions and evaluate different versions against labeled examples.
tools.tradeoff: Telemetry can include customer material. Choose export fields, sampling and retention explicitly.
tools.prompt: Turn one reviewed failure into an offline case with a reference answer and authoritative final state.

tools.name: Inspect AI
tools.fit: Build repeatable model evaluation tasks with datasets, solvers and scorers in Python.
tools.tradeoff: A benchmark task needs a fixture that reflects what your product is allowed to do.
tools.prompt: Define a booking task with a simulated lookup tool and a scorer for false confirmations.

tools.name: OpenCost
tools.fit: Allocate Kubernetes infrastructure costs when teams share a cluster.
tools.tradeoff: Shared idle capacity and provider charges outside the cluster need explicit treatment.
tools.prompt: Show allocated, shared and uncovered costs before comparing two inference deployments.

tools.name: uPlot
tools.fit: Render compact time-series charts for event rates, latency or queue depth.
tools.tradeoff: Charts need units, zoom behavior and an accessible summary. Keep high-cardinality labels out of the overview.
tools.prompt: Plot actual queue age by time and provide the latest value, unit and timestamp in text.

tools.name: vis-timeline
tools.fit: Show ranges and point events for work that spans people, services and time zones.
tools.tradeoff: Overlapping items and rescheduling need stable identifiers and explicit time-zone policy.
tools.prompt: Show approval waits and tool attempts on separate rows and preserve their IDs after reconnect.

tools.name: React Virtuoso
tools.fit: Virtualize a long activity feed with variable-height rows.
tools.tradeoff: New events should not pull an operator away from a historical record being inspected.
tools.prompt: Append 100 fixture events while the user reads an older row, preserving position and keyboard focus.

tools.name: Microsoft Presidio
tools.fit: Identify and anonymize selected sensitive fields in text before secondary use.
tools.tradeoff: Recognition varies by language and entity. Test local names and account formats with synthetic fixtures.
tools.prompt: Compare missed and unnecessary redactions on approved Arabic and English examples.

tools.name: TruffleHog
tools.fit: Check authorized repositories and build inputs for exposed secrets as part of release hygiene.
tools.tradeoff: Treat findings as sensitive and establish who can rotate affected credentials.
tools.prompt: Specify a release gate and the incident owner for a seeded test credential without printing the value.

tools.name: OWASP Threat Dragon
tools.fit: Document system data flows, trust boundaries and defensive controls during design.
tools.tradeoff: A diagram goes stale as tools and data sources change. Review it alongside the deployment diff.
tools.prompt: Trace a customer lookup and an approval through the system and identify the enforcement point on each boundary.

tools.name: in-toto
tools.fit: Record and verify attestations about how software artifacts were produced.
tools.tradeoff: An attestation is only useful when deployment verifies trusted identities and the intended artifact digest.
tools.prompt: Describe which release evidence the deployment checks before admitting a worker image.
